DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the EIP-712 domain separator for the EIP-2612 permit.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the amount of tokens that `spender` can spend on behalf of `owner`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens. Emits a {Approval} event.

attestCanonicalBudget(bytes32,uint256).details: MUST be called only by the immutable `canonicalHook`. The token         silently ignores attestations whose `poolId` is not the single         canonical pool id pinned at construction — so a side / open pool         on the same shared hook can never earn an exemption budget. The         budget lives in EIP-1153 transient storage: it accumulates         within a tx and auto-clears at tx end. Amount-pinned (NOT a         boolean) and fungible within the tx: it CAN subsidize a same-tx         side-pool outflow, but only up to the realized canonical PCT-out         attested this tx (bounded). The exemption therefore only ever         benefits a buyer already concentrating real volume on canonical,         and a side / `initializePoolOpen` pool can never earn budget, so         burned tax proceeds are never a bid-funding source.

params.amount: Realized PCT amount leaving the PoolManager to a trader/LP.
params.poolId: The V4 pool id the attesting swap/removal acted on.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `owner`.

params.admin_: Initial admin address (also stored as the original admin).
params.context_: Freeform context string (for UIs or additional data).
params.image_: Image URL used in the default contract URI.
params.renderer_: Optional metadata renderer contract (zero = built-in default).
params.tax_: Venue-scoped buy-tax config. Pass an `enabled = false` value        (the standard deploy path's `_emptyTaxConfig()`) for the dormant        default; only PC's launch passes `enabled = true`.

decimals().details: Returns the decimals places of the token.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value is used to compute the signature for EIP-2612 permit.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over the tokens of `owner`, authorized by a signed approval by `owner`. Emits a {Approval} event.

renounceAdmin().details: After this call, no further admin actions are possible:      no metadata updates and no renderer swaps.

setMetadataRenderer(address).details: Pass the zero address to fall back to the built-in default renderer.      A non-zero renderer must have contract code at the address — this      blocks the foot-gun of pointing at an EOA, which would make      `contractURI()` and `tokenURI()` revert until the admin resets.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token.

totalSupply().details: Returns the amount of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Solady's `transfer`/`transferFrom` do NOT call the internal      `_transfer`; they inline the balance update. So the tax must be      applied by overriding the public entry points and re-dispatching to      `_transfer` for the actual moves. Allowance/Permit2 semantics are      preserved: `transferFrom` debits the FULL `amount` once via      `_spendAllowance` (which short-circuits the infinite Permit2      allowance), matching exactly what the caller signed for.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` tokens from `from` to `to`. Note: Does not update the allowance if it is the maximum uint256 value. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. - The caller must have at least `amount` of allowance to transfer the tokens of `from`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

updateAdmin(address).details: Reverts on zero address — to give up admin entirely, use `renounceAdmin`.

params.admin_: The new admin address (must be non-zero).

attestCanonicalBudget(bytes32,uint256).notice: The canonical hook attests the exact PCT amount a canonical         buy (or canonical LP removal) moves OUT of the V4 PoolManager,         so the token can exempt exactly that much of the venue→trader         transfer that follows later in the same tx.

burn(uint256).notice: Burns `amount` tokens held by the caller.

burnFrom(address,uint256).notice: Burns `amount` tokens from `account`, debiting caller's allowance.

canonicalHook().notice: The canonical hook authorized to attest (immutable).

canonicalPoolId().notice: The single factory-blessed canonical pool id (immutable).

constructor.notice: Deploys the token. Mints `maxSupply_` to `msg.sender` (the factory).

isTaxExempt(address).notice: Whether `account` is an allowlisted recipient exempt from the tax.

isTaxVenue(address).notice: Whether `account` is a venue whose PCT outflows are taxed.

isVerified().notice: Returns whether this token has been verified by the original admin.

metadataRenderer().notice: Returns the configured metadata renderer contract (zero if using default).

originalAdmin().notice: Returns the original admin address (set at construction, never changes).

renounceAdmin().notice: Permanently renounces admin authority over this token.

setMetadataRenderer(address).notice: Sets a metadata renderer contract to override the default contract URI.

setTaxBps(uint16).notice: Update the buy-tax rate. Token-admin only (on PC the admin is         `TokenAdminPoker`, whose `setTokenTaxBps` enforces the two-key         carve-out so the rate stays tunable past the 1y admin lock).         Bounded `[0, taxBpsMax]` — can only lower or restore, never         exceed the parity cap.

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: ERC-165 introspection — supports ERC20 and ERC165.

taxBps().notice: Current buy-tax rate in bps (10_000 = 100%). Bounded `[0, taxBpsMax]`.

taxBpsMax().notice: Hard parity cap for `taxBps` (immutable). The bounded setter can         never raise the rate above this.

taxBurnAddress().notice: Burn sink the tax skim is routed to (immutable, e.g. 0xdEaD).

taxEnabled().notice: True once the tax feature is switched on (immutable at deploy).

taxPoolManager().notice: V4 PoolManager singleton — the dominant venue (covers ALL V4         pools with one immutable compare on the transfer hot path).

transfer(address,uint256).notice: Transfer override routing through the venue-scoped tax path.

updateAdmin(address).notice: Transfers the admin role. Only callable by the current admin.

updateImage(string).notice: Updates the token's image URL. Only callable by the admin.

updateMetadata(string).notice: Updates the token's metadata/description. Only callable by the admin.

verify().notice: One-time verification signal emitted by the original admin.
